# Remove a card-loaded payload before a PC firmware update

A PC/USB update runs inside the running application, so the loader and its payload are active while flash is written.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M10 Mark II firmware 1.4, build 1400](../firmware/em10-ii-1400.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 Mark II](../cameras/em10-ii.md)

On the E-M10 Mark II the OK-held card update starts before the loader and is not affected; the PC update is driven by the booted camera. Take FENYKL.BIN and FENYKL.TST off the card first. Other card loaders have their own rules for update cards.

> **What happens:** Plugin code runs while the body firmware is written; the effect has not been characterised.

**Symptoms:** [Firmware update or recovery at risk](index.md#recovery-at-risk)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([fenykl](../projects/fenykl.md)): The SDK forbids a USB/PC update with FENYKL.BIN on the card because the payload would run while flash is written. Source: [fenykl plugin SDK](../sources/fenykl.sdk.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/atx/fenykl/blob/dd8dde0ead63bfc2a722f65a7b86e19577ad9778/README.md#how-to-install-on-the-e-m10-mark-ii)**
